Name: One Click Shed Reloader
Author: bitwisejon
Description:
[b]One Click Shed Reloader[/b] is a [url=http://stardewvalley.net/]Stardew Valley[/url] v1.6 mod which lets you harvest and reload all supported containers in a Shed, Barn, Coop, Cellar, Cave, or Greenhouse with a single click on the outside of the building. Only the house's/cabin's owner can harvest/reload the cellar in multiplayer. Harvesting/reloading the house/cabin itself is NOT supported by this mod.

[b]Important Note[/b]: In multiplayer, farmhands can only harvest/reload the Cave and their Cellar from within that location due to a limitation of SMAPI and the fact that these locations are not synced with the main game unless a player is in the location. To harvest/reload as a farmhand (or even the main player) in these locations, hover the cursor around the entryway once inside.

If you are feeling generous and want to support my work, you can now [url=https://www.buymeacoffee.com/bitwisejon]Buy me a Coffee[/url]! 

***Version 4.0.0 adds support for SMAPI 4.0 or greater and Stardew Valley v1.6.

[b]Support for Other Mods[/b]
While I do not officially support any other mods except my own, I have added the ability in v4.0.0 for you to support any mods you like by modifying the config file that is created after running Stardew Valley the first time after installing this mod. Launch Stardew Valley one time and then exit. Then open the config.json file in the `Stardew Valley\Mods\OneClickShedReloader` directory. See instructions in that file for how to discover and add new items and buildings to support.

[b]Install[/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Install this mod by unzipping the downloaded mod into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.  [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_FAQs]Instructions[/url]﻿.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b]Use[/b]
[list]
[*]Hover the cursor over a supported building to get instant info about the containers in the building that are ready to harvest and reload.
[*]Move closer to the building and left-click the outside to harvest all ready containers within.
[*]If you are holding an item that can be loaded into an empty container within the building, it will be loaded automatically when left-clicking the building.  This can be done at the same time as harvesting which makes managing buildings full of containers much easier!
[*]This mod allows you to take full advantage of all available space within a location since there is never a need to enter it again!
[*]The Cellar, Cave, and Greenhouse can now be harvested/reloaded from inside by hovering the cursor over the entryway.
[/list]
[b]Supported Buildings[/b]
The following buildings are currently supported. 
[list]
[*]Shed
[*]Barn (any size)
[*]Coop (any size)
[*]Cellar (in the main house or a cabin - only the home owner can do this!)
[*]Cave
[*]Greenhouse
[/list] 
[b]Supported Containers[/b]
The following containers are currently supported.
[list]
[*]Auto-Grabber
[*]Bee House
[*]Cask
[*]Charcoal Kiln
[*]Cheese Press
[*]Crystalarium
[*]Furnace
[*]Keg
[*]Loom
[*]Mayonnaise Machine
[*]Mushroom Box
[*]Oil Maker
[*]Preserves Jar
[*]Recycling Machine
[/list]
[b]Notes[/b]
This mod does not affect your save game files in any way. Due to the required mouse events, this mod likely only works on PC. Other platforms are not officially supported. There are no known compatibility issues with this mod, but there could be problems with any mod that displays information while hovering the cursor over a building, or with mods that handle click events on buildings. If you discover any problems while using the mod, you can log an issue on the [url=https://github.com/bitwisejon/StardewValleyMods/issues]BitwiseJon GitHub page[/url].  Only U.S. English text is provided at this time.

[b]Mod Compatibility[/b]
[b]Note: [/b]This mod is only compatible with version 1.6 of Stardew Valley (released 3/19/2024) and works in multiplayer as well. 

This mod is fully compatible with:
[list]
[*][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2070]Instant Buildings from Farm[/url]﻿ by me
[/list]
